title: Ordinary evaluation formula directly on a scheme site
statement: Let Y be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let P,F be actual cochain complexes of O_Y-modules [def-pur-hom-complex]. Put O=O_Y[0], V=Hom(P,O), and T=Tot(F tensor V) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For f:T to Hom(P,F), the scheme-site ordinary evaluation formula means the following equation. For every integers p,q,n,r with p+q=n, follow the (p,q) tensor summand inclusion by f^n and the r-th Hom projection [lem-sc-hom-complex-projections]. If r+q is not zero, this composite is zero. Otherwise it is the sheaf tensor-Hom curry [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed] of the map (F^p tensor V^q) tensor P^r to F^(r+n) obtained by the associator, the r-th projection V^q to Hom(P^r,O^0), evaluation, the canonical O^0 to O_Y isomorphism, the right unit action, and p=r+n. The outer symmetry puts P^r first for the chosen tensorHomEquiv. This is the scheme-site version of [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data], with no over-site carrier.

def IsSchemeOrdinaryEvaluation (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P F : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (f : pullbackTensorTotal Y F
        (homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P
          ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (.up ℤ) 0).obj
            (𝟙_ (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))))) ⟶
      homComplex (R := Y.sheaf) P F) : Prop
